fullContentHtml:
RPSC Assistant Professor (Medical Edu.) Result 2026 (Update) - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the result for the post of Assistant Professor (Medical Education). This recruitment was released for 329 posts. The applications for RPSC Assistant Professor (Medical Edu.) Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 31 December 2025 to 29 January 2025. The written examination was held on 03-04 July 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RPSC Assistant Professor (Medical Edu.) Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date : 11 December 2024
  • Application Start Date : 31 December 2024
  • Last Date : 29 January 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 January 2025
  • Exam Date : 03-04 July 2025
  • Admit Card : 30 June 2025
  • Answer Key : 23 September 2025
  • Result Update : 22 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, BC, EBC (CL), Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • BC, EBC, EWS (NCL) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC/ ST/ PwD Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
